milestone: Phase 3 M3 - Monetization, Growth Instrumentation and Feedback
conclusion: The Android RevenueCat public key blocker is now cleared, but the remaining M3 staging upgrade/restore validation cannot be truthfully closed until the app is installed from a Google Play internal/staging track and real sandbox purchase/restore proof is captured.

cleared_findings.finding: The Android build now has REVENUECAT_PUBLIC_ANDROID_KEY configured.
cleared_findings.evidence: apps/mobile/android/gradle.properties contains a non-blank REVENUECAT_PUBLIC_ANDROID_KEY value; only length was verified, not printed.
cleared_findings.verification: JAVA_HOME="C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr" ./gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin --console=plain passed on 2026-04-16 after the key was configured.

blocking_findings.finding: The connected phone has com.thesis.mobile installed without a Google Play installer source.
blocking_findings.impact: A real Google Billing / RevenueCat staging purchase requires a Play-installed internal/staging build and tester account.
blocking_findings.evidence: adb dumpsys package com.thesis.mobile reported installerPackageName=null.

coverage: internal feedback queue filtering and authorization

fresh_checks_completed.note: Build succeeded with existing Android Gradle Plugin compileSdk warning only.

coverage: server-authoritative sync-tier with mocked RevenueCat subscriber
Free daily Deep Dive limit reset after subscription timezone midnight
sync-tier rejects RevenueCat app user IDs not bound to caller

non_blocking_observation.observation: Running the full subscription.test.js file in one process timed out/hung after two passed tests and one reported failure marker, but all three subscription tests passed when executed individually by name.

play_identity_alignment.decision: Future Play/internal testing updates must target the existing Play package com.voltfinance.voltapp with versionCode >= 42607. Local debug remains com.thesis.mobile unless an explicit Gradle override is supplied.
implemented_guardrails: Gradle now accepts ANDROID_APPLICATION_ID, ANDROID_VERSION_CODE, and ANDROID_VERSION_NAME overrides.
Gradle rejects com.voltfinance.voltapp builds with ANDROID_VERSION_CODE below 42607.
Google Services plugin is only applied when google-services.json contains a client matching the selected applicationId.

checks.note: Play identity override compiles. Firebase plugin is skipped because the checked-in google-services.json only matches com.thesis.mobile.
Debug artifact assembled for identity verification only; do not install over the Play app because debug signing will not match Play signing.
Version guard rejected the old Play versionCode.
Release bundle stops on missing API_BASE_URL_RELEASE; release API/cert config and Play upload signing are still required before an uploadable artifact can be produced.

required_to_close: Produce and upload a Play internal/staging artifact for com.voltfinance.voltapp with versionCode >= 42607.
Provide release API/certificate-pin properties and Play upload signing material required for an uploadable release bundle.
Provide a Firebase google-services.json client for com.voltfinance.voltapp before shipping push-enabled Play builds.
Install the updated app from a Google Play internal/staging testing track using a licensed tester account.
Run a real sandbox upgrade purchase from Free to Pro and capture server-authoritative /v1/user/profile or /v1/user/sync-tier proof showing PRO.
Run a real restore purchase flow after clearing/reinstalling or using a restore-capable test account and capture server-authoritative proof.
Update M3 smoke plan Steps 3 and 4 from TBD to PASS with the captured evidence.
decision_needed: Owner must provide Play upload access/signing, release API/cert-pin config, a matching Firebase config for com.voltfinance.voltapp if push is required, and a licensed tester account before strict closeout can proceed.
